title: stories.json
description: User stories compiled from PRD.md by gen_stories.py. Title and acceptance come from the PRD; status, surfaces, devices and waits_on are preserved across regenerations.

id.description: Stable story id, e.g. US-01. Never reused.

acceptance.description: Numbered acceptance criteria from the PRD, in order. Criterion n is referenced as US-01.n.

surfaces.description: Routes or screens the story is visible on, e.g. /login.

devices.description: Device profiles the story must pass on, e.g. phone-390x844, tablet-820x1180, desktop-1440x900, ios-sim, android-emu.

status.description: NOT_BUILT: no code. BUILT: on a branch or deployed but not verified. PARTIAL: deployed, some criteria fail (name them in notes). LIVE: deployed and every criterion PASSED by the story-verifier. PARKED: deliberately not now (cite the D-id in notes).

waits_on.description: Story ids, task ids, requirement ids or decision ids that must be done first.

covers.description: Requirement ids (R-01) this story covers, from the (R-01) after the PRD heading.

evidence.description: Verifier report paths, PR links, done-gate run ids.
